sources.entry: Joplin - Note taking application with markdown editor and encryption support for mobile and desktop platforms. Runs client-side and syncs through a self hosted Nextcloud instance or similar (alternative to Evernote). (Source Code) MIT Nodejs
joplin - Note taking and to-do application with synchronization capabilities for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.

summary.one_liner: Joplin is a free, open source note-taking and to-do application with Markdown notes, end-to-end encrypted sync, and apps for desktop, mobile, and web clipping.
summary.what_it_does: Organizes a large number of notes into notebooks, with tagging, copying, and editing from the apps or an external text editor. Notes are stored in Markdown format. It can import Evernote exports (converting formatted content to Markdown, including resources and metadata) and plain Markdown files. It is described as offline first, so all data is kept on the device. Notes can be synced end-to-end encrypted through Nextcloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, or Joplin Cloud. Full-text search, plugins, and themes are available, and a Web Clipper for Firefox and Chrome saves pages and screenshots.
use_cases: take and organize notes across devices
sync encrypted notes to Nextcloud or Dropbox
clip web pages and screenshots from the browser
notable: Offline-first: all data available on device without internet
Evernote import preserving formatting, resources, and metadata
Plugin and theme system for customization
Web Clipper extension for Firefox and Chrome
caveats: Donations are requested to fund development; the README does not describe paid tiers beyond Joplin Cloud being a sync option.
Sync requires a cloud service or self-hosted backend such as Nextcloud; the README does not describe a standalone server.
